answer: Divergent Reply Challenge. Each identity must return a per-epoch nonce derived from its private state and a shared terrace of public inputs, and answers are cross-checked by neighbors. Clones forced to copy the same state emit identical replies, which an echo detector flags as one lineage. Honest agents diverge freely, passing through a narrow inlet of accepted variance. An attacker must run genuinely independent instances with distinct state and timing, paying full compute and coordination cost per identity instead of one cost amortized across many.
